model: BACnet Programmable Fume Hood Controller - Application 6740 (2-Position Constant Volume with Damper)
applies_to: Constant volume or two-position fume hoods with an exhaust damper on a manifolded exhaust system, run by the Siemens BACnet programmable fume hood controller with an operator display panel.
summary: Application 6740 runs a constant volume or two-position fume hood on a Siemens BACnet programmable fume hood controller over BACnet MS/TP. It modulates the hood exhaust damper to hold a high or low exhaust airflow setpoint (EXH HI STPT / EXH LO STPT), picked by DI 2 or the left display button. It raises low/high flow warnings and alarms against the setpoint, has an emergency purge mode, and sends a 1-10 V exhaust flow signal on AO 2.
notes: AI and BI objects are read-only. AO and BO objects are BACnet output objects with a priority array; the guide has no access column, so access is inferred from object type. Many AOs are calculated status values, not commands.
Instances shown in braces in the guide may be unbundled at a field panel; that marking is not reproduced here.
Units are given in US units (cfm, ft², inH2O); the guide also lists SI factory defaults.
The high setpoint is used if either DI2 STPT SW (BI 37) or ODP STPT SW (BO 22) is HI; both must be LO for the low setpoint.
STARTUP MODE (AO 21): 0 = normal, 1 and 2 = decommission modes, 3 = start-up with alarms off (factory default).
Alarm and warning limits (AO 10-13) are percentages of the active exhaust setpoint.
The point table lists a binary output named DI 4 (BO 56); it is kept as printed.

source.title: BACnet Programmable Fume Hood Controller 2-Position Constant Volume with Damper, Application 6740, Application Note

integration.summary: Address the controller on the BACnet MS/TP trunk (manually or with auto addressing) and set STARTUP MODE to normal. The BMS can select high or low flow with ODP STPT SW (BO 22), adjust the two exhaust setpoints, and reads exhaust airflow, the active setpoint and the alarm points.

minimum_points.name: ODP STPT SW
minimum_points.why: HI = high exhaust setpoint (also set by DI 2)

integration.enable: No enable point: the controller runs its sequence once STARTUP MODE (AO 21) is 0. The flow setpoint is high when DI 2 or the left display button (ODP STPT SW, BO 22) is HI.
setup: BACnet MS/TP only. CTLR ADDRESS (AO 1) holds the MS/TP address; the point table lists its factory value as 99.
APPLICATION (AO 2) holds the application number; the point table lists its factory default as 6700.
gotchas: STARTUP MODE (AO 21) ships at 3 (start-up: control works but alarms are off and the display shows Startup). Set it to 0 for normal operation; 1 and 2 are decommission modes.

Emergency purge from the display button (or DI 6) overrides all other control: EMER ALM is set at BACnet priority 1, the damper opens fully for EMER TIMER, then flow holds at EXH STPT times the EMER STPT percentage until the button is pressed again.
If the controller loses power, the exhaust damper goes fully open.
With a digital room unit (revision 26 and later), a command sent through the room unit puts the matching BACnet input Out Of Service.
Loop gains, duct and sash dimensions, calibration and display settings are commissioning values; don't write them from the BMS routinely.
